battle.name: 鍾離之戰
battle.brief: 梁魏在淮河中游的邊境戰事。北魏軍在洞浦得手後進逼鍾離，梁武帝遣臨川王蕭宏率眾赴援，兩軍隔淮相持至春，魏軍因糧援不繼北退，鍾離未陷。守城的重點在弓弩壓制與近身格鬥：卡面這件埃及月牙劍是外彎單刃的砍殺器，鍾離城頭對應它的，是梁軍步騎通用的環首刀與長槊。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰的兩方是南朝梁與北魏。梁以都城建康為樞紐，蕭衍在位，北邊的兵事先後牽動徐州、豫州兩道：徐州治彭城，控淮水下游與南北水運；豫州治壽陽，扼淮河中游，屏蔽江淮之間的門戶。鍾離是這條線上的一座邊城，位在淮河北岸，行政上歸徐州刺史部序列，軍糧與援兵卻多自壽陽方向接濟，因此守鍾離的兵，實際上由兩道將領共同支應。北魏方面，孝文帝崩後由高宗肅文帝拓跋詔在位，樞機落在權宦劉騰與諸王將領手中；淮南線由平西將軍楊大眼等分道出兵，前進基地是壽春、合肥與義陽，兵員以北方騎兵為骨幹，攻城所賴的撞輪、雲梯、發石之屬則隨軍徵發。梁以守城為本，魏以拔城為本；鍾離之役正是這兩種取向第一次在淮河中游正面相撞。兩邊的指揮體系也不一樣：梁的州刺史既管民政又統軍，軍中另設領軍將軍、武衛將軍之類的職銜，援軍由中央下詔調發；魏的前線以將軍領兵，淮南方面的兵與糧逐步交由行臺與屯田體制統籌，軍戶屯田與州郡解運並用，調兵則倚仗騎兵與徵發的步卒。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Southern Liang and the Northern Wei. Liang was organised around its capital at Jiankang, with Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, on the throne, and the conduct of affairs in the north split between two regional commands: Xu Province, administered from Pengcheng, which controlled the lower Huai and the water transport between north and south, and Yu Province, administered from Shouyang, which gripped the middle Huai and shielded the corridor between the Yangzi and the Huai. Zhongli was a frontier city on that line, sitting on the north bank of the Huai. Administratively it belonged to the Xu provincial establishment, yet its supply and its reinforcements came mostly from the direction of Shouyang, so the garrison there was in practice fed by officers appointed from two different commands. On the Wei side, after Emperor Xiaowen died, the throne was held by his grandson Emperor Gaozong of Wei, Tuoba Zhao, while the effective power of the central court rested with the powerful eunuch Liu Teng and with the princes and generals around him. The Huai River front was opened by generals such as Yang Dayan, the General Who Pacified the West, who moved out in several columns; their forward bases were Shouchun, Hefei and Yiyang. Their manpower rested on northern cavalry, while the equipment for assaulting walls, battering rams, scaling ladders and stone-throwing engines, was collected and carried with the columns. Liang fought to hold its cities; Wei fought to take them. The battle at Zhongli was the first time these two doctrines collided face to face in the middle reaches of the Huai.
people: 梁武帝蕭衍坐鎮建康，下詔令臨川王蕭宏總督諸軍赴援鍾離。蕭宏是蕭衍的皇子，時任司空並領揚州，處事一味持重，兵至淮上卻逗留不進，先與魏軍相持而後伺隙，終為史書所譏。前此一年在洞浦負責淮南防務的曹仲宗已被魏軍擊破，兵退鍾離，鍾離守軍的聲威尚未建立。真正令鍾離成名的是昌義之，他在十二年後的大戰中名震南北：魏冠軍將軍元英大軍壓境，守將昌義之以孤城拒之，韋叡在下游築卻月堰截斷淮水，曹景宗乘夜出擊，魏軍崩潰，死傷十餘萬，血流漂杵；韋叡、曹景宗亦因此役被記住，曹景宗坐功不賞，鬱鬱而發疾而死。北魏一側，先後在鍾離方向出現的是楊大眼與刁雍：前者勇而少謀，後者長於治軍，曉得糧道與屯田的分寸；再往後是元英，孝文帝的次子，少年從軍，累戰之後成為魏在南方最難纏的統帥。戰線後方還站着一名南朝舊人蕭寶夔，南齊末年鍾離的叛軍曾推他為主，他兵敗後奔魏，被封為齊王、頓丘公，成為魏對南方施壓時一張可以擺上檯面的牌。
peopleEn: Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, remained at Jiankang and issued the order sending the Prince of Linchuan, Xiao Hong, to take overall command of the relief force bound for Zhongli. Xiao Hong was a son of the emperor and at that time held the office of Sikong while also governing Yangzhou. He handled everything with excessive caution: once the army reached the Huai he hung back, chose to wait for the enemy rather than advance, and was accordingly faulted in the historical record. The officer who had held the Huai River front the year before, Cao Zhongzong, had already been beaten by the Wei army and had fallen back to Zhongli, so the fame of the city was not yet established. The man who made Zhongli famous was Chang Yizhi, whose name would shake north and south in the great battle twelve years later: when the Wei army of the Champion General, Yuan Ying, closed on the city, Chang Yizhi held it with a handful of men, Wei Rui threw up the Queyue weir downstream to cut the Huai, and Cao Jingzong struck out by night; the Wei army collapsed, losing more than a hundred thousand men with blood floating like red poles. Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong were remembered for it as well, and Cao Jingzong, who received no reward for his share of the victory, was so bitter that he fell ill and died. On the Wei side the officers who appeared in the Zhongli direction were first Yang Dayan and Diao Yong, the former brave but short of stratagem, the latter skilled at command and careful about the exact cost of supply lines and garrison farms; later came Yuan Ying, the second son of Emperor Xiaowen, who had ridden with the army from boyhood and became the most awkward opponent Wei had in the south. Behind the front stood one survivor of the southern court, Xiao Baokui: the rebels at Zhongli in the last years of the Southern Qi had acclaimed him as their leader, and after his defeat he fled to Wei, was granted the title Prince of Qi and then Duke of Dunqiu, and became a card Wei could lay on the table when it wished to press the south.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是埃及月牙劍：早王朝埃及人用的外彎單刃短劍，刃形像一彎新月的兩端，揮砍時靠重量與弧度把斬傷壓深，砍中便不必抽拔。它出現於公元前一千五百年上下，與本役的年代相去逾一千五百年，鍾離城頭自然不會出現這樣的劍；它在此處的意義，是作為一柄單刃弧刃砍殺器的代表，指出這場攻防中真正決定貼身搏鬥的那一類兵器在中國的對應物。梁軍步騎通用的佩刀是環首刀一系：刀身有直刃，亦有外側起弧者，柄端作環以便懸掛，戰時單手揮砍，近身格鬥的用法與月牙刃同一路數；長兵器則是槊，用以破甲與衝鋒，正面以矛、戟列陣，遠程靠弓與弩，床弩、蹶張弩供守城壓制攻城者，箭簇以骨與鐵為之。護具是札甲與魚鱗甲，配鎧鍔、兜鍪，士卒執大盾當前列。攻城一方備撞車、撞輪、雲梯、發石車，並備水火之物以焚燒城門與樓櫃。代步與運輸上，魏軍重騎，具馬鎔並給馬披甲，江南軍馬少而以徒兵為主；輜重靠牛車，糧秣靠淮河船運，粟、麥、稻自壽春、彭城轉運，芍陂一帶的軍屯是最近的補充。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh, a short single-edged sword with an outward curve used by the people of Egypt in the early dynastic period, its blade shaped like the two horns of a crescent moon; the swing drives weight and curvature into the cut and makes deep wounds, and because the edge is single and curved the sword need not be twisted free after it lands. It belongs to around fifteen hundred years before the present, some fifteen centuries before the fighting in this dossier, and no such sword stood on the walls of Zhongli. Its relevance here is as the representative of a single-edged curved chopping weapon: it identifies the class of arms that actually decided close fighting in this siege, and that class had a Chinese equivalent. The standard side arm of Liang infantry and cavalry was the ring-pommel dao: some blades were straight, others curved along the outer edge, the hilt ending in a ring so the sword could be slung at the hip, and in action it was swung one-handed, its use in hand-to-hand work following the same logic as the khopesh. The long weapon was the shao, employed to break armour and to lead a charge; the front line was formed with spears and halberds; missiles were provided by the bow and by the crossbow, the bed crossbow and the draw-loaded crossbow being used from the walls to hold assaulting troops down, with bone and iron arrowheads. Body protection was provided by lamellar and scale armour, with shoulder guards and helmets, and the front rank carried large shields. The assaulting side brought battering rams and ram wheels, scaling ladders and stone-throwing engines, and carried water and fire to burn gates and wall towers. For movement and supply the Wei fielded heavy cavalry with bridles and armoured horses, while Liang in the south had too few horses and fought mainly on foot; baggage train was drawn by oxen, and grain, millet and rice came by boat along the Huai out of Shouchun and Pengcheng, with the garrison farms around the Quebei marsh providing the nearest replenishment.
tactics: 鍾離之役的骨架是渡口與糧道之爭。梁的部署以城為軸：鍾離據淮河北岸，面淮築壁，外設濠塹與營壘，遊騎出城抄掠魏軍的側後與糧隊，城頭以弓弩覆壓城外，援軍則列營於城南，隔水相望，伺其疲。蕭宏大軍集結多時而進兵遲緩，兩軍在淮上僵持，彼此都在等對方先動。魏軍的辦法是先以騎兵遮斷糧運、把援軍與守軍隔開，再用撞車與雲梯集中於一處缺口，鼓角雜作之中掩護步卒衝鋒；屯於壽春、合肥的糧船與牛車把糧食一批批送到軍前，遠距離運轉是這支軍隊的長處，也是它的負擔。氣候同樣決定節奏：冬季淮河多不封凍，騎兵可涉水而渡；春雨一來泥淖陷輪，車不得行，攻方不得不把主力施力放在夏秋乾季，士卒又受暑濕之苦。十二年後的鍾離之役給了雙方一份樣板：韋叡在淮水下游築卻月堰，斷水淹營，再以舟師與騎兵合擊，結果是魏軍在鍾離城下崩潰。
tacticsEn: The skeleton of the battle at Zhongli was a contest over the fords and the supply line. Liang organised everything around the city: Zhongli stood on the north bank of the Huai with a revetted face toward the water, moats and field works outside, out-riders riding out of the gates to cut at the flank of the Wei army and at its baggage trains, bows and crossbows on the walls sweeping the ground below, while the relief army camped south of the river, watched the water and waited for the enemy to tire. Xiao Hong gathered a large force but advanced slowly, and the two armies stalemated on the Huai, each waiting for the other to move first. Wei's method was to use cavalry to sever the grain traffic and to hold the relief army apart from the garrison, then to concentrate battering rams and scaling ladders on a single breach, masking the foot with the noise of drums and horns as the ranks charged. Grain barges and ox carts staged at Shouchun and Hefei delivered food to the front in instalments; long-range haulage was the strength of that army and also its burden. Climate set the rhythm as much as men did: the Huai rarely froze in winter, so cavalry could ford it, but spring rain turned the ground to mud that trapped wheels and stopped carts, forcing the attacker to concentrate his effort in the dry season, and the men laboured in summer heat and damp. The later battle at Zhongli handed both sides a model to copy: Wei Rui threw up the Queyue weir on the lower Huai to flood the Wei camp, and then combined river craft with cavalry, and the Wei army came apart at the foot of Zhongli's walls.
data: 年號可以對得上：梁武帝天監元年為公元五〇二年，五〇七年是天監六年，戰事便落在天監末年的邊境線上。鍾離的地理坐標至今可尋：在今安徽鳳陽縣境，淮河中游北岸，東隔濠水與臨淮相望，與今蚌埠隔河相對；西距壽春數十里，過壽春即是淮南膏腴的芍陂、合肥一帶屯田；東去彭城約二百餘里，南抵建康水路約二百里，是南朝北方防線上一座不靠海而當淮水咽喉的城。建制上，鍾離秦置縣，漢升為郡，魏晉仍為鍾離縣，隋改臨淮縣，唐置濠州，明代為鳳陽府；名字換了，城址始終在淮河北岸那片高阜上。城有內外兩重，外城周圍有濠，淮水一面倚水為險，倚城為守。兵員方面，正史沒有留下確數，只能按渡口數、營壘數與糧運規模推：兩家在淮上對峙的兵都在數萬量級，留守城中的當是數千之數。前一年洞浦之役，記錄留有斬首萬餘級的數目，可作魏軍攻勢規模的參照；再往後十二年，同一座城下的另一場大戰，魏軍死傷十餘萬、血流漂杵，則是鍾離這座城在整個南北朝時期的份量。
dataEn: The reign title fixes the chronology: the first year of Tianjian under Emperor Wu of Liang was 502 CE, so 507 was the sixth year of Tianjian, and the fighting sits on the frontier line of that late period. The site of Zhongli can still be located: it lies in present-day Fengyang county in Anhui, on the north bank of the middle Huai, looking across the Hao watercourse towards Linhuai, directly opposite today's Bengbu. It is some tens of li west of Shouchun, and beyond Shouchun lie the rich country and the garrison farms around the Quebei marsh and Hefei; it is roughly two hundred li east to Pengcheng and about two hundred li of water south to Jiankang. On the north bank of the Huai the city was a stronghold that had nothing to do with the sea but sat astride the throat of the river. Administratively, Zhongli began as a county under the Qin, was raised to a commandery under the Han, remained a county through Wei and Jin, was renamed Linhuai under the Sui, became a prefecture at Haozhou under the Tang and the seat of Fengyang prefecture under the Ming; the name changed but the site never moved from that raised ground above the north bank. The fortress had inner and outer walls, a ditch around the outer circuit, and on the river side it used the water itself as a barrier while resting on the walls for defence. As for numbers, the official histories leave no exact figures, and all that can be done is to reason from the number of fords, the size of the camps and the scale of the supply traffic: the armies facing each other on the Huai were each in the tens of thousands, and the garrison left inside the walls was of the order of several thousand. In the previous year's fighting at Dongpu the record keeps a figure of more than a thousand enemy dead, which serves as a reference for the scale of the Wei offensive; and twelve years after that, at the very same walls, a different battle left the Wei army with more than a hundred thousand casualties and blood floating like red poles, which measures the standing of the city of Zhongli across the whole Southern and Northern Dynasties.
cause: 打起來的原因是北方的進攻條件與南方的守成之間沒有一個穩定的平衡。梁武帝天監初年把精力放在內政與典章上，邊防多採守禦與屯田，淮北幾處要城雖在手中，卻因兵少、糧緊而守得相當勉強；義陽方向的防線在五〇三年前後的戰事裡已經被魏軍突破，鍾離遂成北面最前面的一道門。魏要的是淮北的渡口與屯田：奪下鍾離，就等於把梁從壽春、彭城往淮南輸糧的門戶和芍陂一帶的膏腴之地一併捏在手上，南方水軍北上與北方騎兵南下都會被卡在這一段河曲裡。於是北魏在義陽、壽春兩面配合，主力壓向淮河中游，試圖用一次圍城把梁在北方的整條防線拉斷。南朝內部也不是沒有人主張用兵，但鍾離偏偏卡在兩道之間，援兵調度、糧秣徵集、馬匹補充三件事都慢半拍，這半拍就是這場戰役只能打成消耗而無法速決的真正原因。
causeEn: The fighting began because there was no stable balance between Wei's conditions for attack and Liang's habit of holding what it had. In the early years of Tianjian Emperor Wu of Liang put his energy into administration and ritual, and the frontier was defended by holding and by garrison farms; the key cities north of the Huai were in Liang's hands, but with too few men and too tight a grain supply they were held only just. The line at Yiyang had already been broken by Wei in the fighting around 503, and Zhongli became the foremost gate on the northern front. What Wei wanted was the fords and the farms of the Huai north of the river: to take Zhongli was to close at one stroke the mouth through which Liang moved grain from Shouchun and Pengcheng into the Huai basin, and to take the rich ground around the Quebei marsh, so that a southern fleet moving north and northern cavalry moving south would both be caught in that bend of the river. Wei accordingly pressed from the Yiyang and Shouchun directions at once, driving the main body into the middle Huai in the attempt to snap the whole northern defensive line with a single siege. It was not that nobody in the south argued for war, but Zhongli lay exactly between the two commands, and mobilisation of reinforcements, collection of grain and replacement of horses were all half a beat behind, and that half beat is the real reason the campaign turned into an attritional contest that could not be decided quickly. The two command systems were not alike either: under Liang a provincial governor was both an administrator and a commander, the army carried titles such as General Who Leads the Army and General of the Armed Guard, and the reinforcements were summoned by decree from the centre. In Wei the line was led by generals, while the troops and the grain of the Huai region were gradually brought under the regional administrations and the garrison-farm system, with military households entered in the registers and pay drawn from the farms and from the prefectures, cavalry and conscripted foot carrying the burden of movement.
impact: 這場戰役留下的痕跡，多半不在戰果而在制度與人事上。梁軍保住了鍾離，淮北門戶暫時穩定，卻也暴露了南朝邊防的真實體量：守一座中等規模的邊城要耗掉數千兵與數月糧運，增援卻要從數百里外調集，兩者之間的落差，逼出後來更系統的軍屯與漕運安排，芍陂、合肥一帶的屯田因此更被看重，淮水上的運糧船隊也被提到與戰兵同等的位置。人事上，蕭宏因統軍赴援而權柄更重，軍中紀律卻不嚴，役後他很快坐大，兩年後便因驕暴被貶出中樞，反映出梁朝以宗室出鎮邊鎮的弊病。北魏方面，攻勢受挫後轉而固守淮北，把重心壓在義陽與壽春，直到十二年後換上冠軍將軍元英重整旗鼓，再度打到鍾離城下，仍以失敗收場。器物層面，這十餘年裡南北裝備互相影響：環首刀、槊、馬鎔的形制逐步定型，江南吸收北方騎兵的裝具，北方也在弓弩與攻城器械上取法南朝，戰爭的消耗與交流，讓這套兵器體系在隋唐之前換了另一副樣子。
impactEn: What this campaign left behind is less a matter of battlefield results than of institutions and personnel. Liang held Zhongli and the gateway to the north of the Huai was stable for the time, but the defence had shown its true scale: holding a mid-sized frontier city tied down several thousand men and months of grain, while the relief had to be dragged in from several hundred li away, and that gap between the two drove the more systematic garrison-farm and transport arrangements that followed, so that the farms around Quebei and Hefei were held in higher esteem and the grain barges on the Huai were ranked alongside the fighting troops themselves. In terms of personnel, Xiao Hong gained weight from commanding the relief, though discipline in his army was poor, and he grew arrogant so quickly that within two years he was demoted out of the central command for his misconduct, which exposed the weakness of Liang's practice of putting imperial princes in charge of frontier commands. On the Wei side the checked offensive turned into consolidation of the line north of the Huai, with the weight of effort concentrated on Yiyang and Shouchun, until twelve years later a new commander in the person of the Champion General Yuan Ying reorganised the effort and came down to the walls of Zhongli again, only to fail a second time. At the level of equipment, the arms of north and south influenced one another across those dozen years: the forms of the ring-pommel dao, the shao and the horse bridle settled down, the south absorbed the fittings of northern cavalry, and the north took lessons from southern bows, crossbows and siege engines, so that the cost and the exchange of this warfare reshaped the whole armaments system into a different form before the Sui and the Tang.
result: 結局是鍾離沒有淪陷。兩軍在淮上相持到春天，魏軍糧援不繼、騎兵久疲，又怕蕭宏的主力全部壓上，於是拔營北退，梁軍追擊遲緩，只取回些失地與俘獲，戰果有限。這一役之後，淮北的拉鋸又延續了十餘年，直到五一九年魏冠軍將軍元英大軍再至鍾離，蕭梁以昌義之守城、韋叡斷水、曹景宗夜擊的配合大破魏軍，魏軍死傷十餘萬，血流漂杵，鍾離之名才真正傳遍南北。就正史留下的文字而言，五〇七年這一戰的記載相當簡略，詳細的經過只在通鑑與梁魏兩書的零星段落裡；可以確定的是，鍾離在這一年仍然握在梁朝手中，淮北的邊防體系由此又撐了十二年，直到那場血流漂杵的大捷之後，攻守之勢才換了位置。魏軍退去之後，鍾離一帶的屯田與渡口重新回到南北拉鋸的前線上，城防隨之修補加固，這座城也從此成為兩家在淮河中游彼此標記位置的固定據點：對梁，它是北門；對魏，它是南下的箭頭。
resultEn: The outcome was that Zhongli did not fall. The two armies stalemated on the Huai until spring, when the Wei army, its grain traffic exhausted and its cavalry worn out by long service, and fearful of Xiao Hong committing his whole main force, broke camp and withdrew north; the Liang pursuit was slow and recovered little beyond some lost ground and prisoners, so the fruits of the campaign were limited. The see-saw over the Huai north of the river then ran on for more than a decade, until 519, when the Wei army of the Champion General Yuan Ying came down to Zhongli once more and Liang broke it with Chang Yizhi holding the city, Wei Rui cutting the river and Cao Jingzong striking by night; the Wei army lost more than a hundred thousand men with blood floating like red poles, and only then did the name of Zhongli become known throughout north and south. As for the written record, the battle of 507 is described very briefly: the detailed course of it survives only in scattered passages of the Comprehensive Mirror and of the histories of Liang and Wei. What can be established is that in that year Zhongli was still held by the Liang court, and that the northern defensive system bought another twelve years, until that great victory with the floating blood reversed the balance of attack and defence. After the Wei army withdrew, the garrison farms and fords around Zhongli went back to being the forward line of the see-saw between north and south, the walls were repaired and reinforced, and the city remained one of the fixed points by which the two states marked their positions on the middle Huai: for Liang it was the northern gate, for Wei it was the arrowhead pointing south.
